_meta.purpose: The gate/friction config surface named in ROADMAP's per-project manager-optimizer bullet (Phase 48 implements). Human-facing gate and friction adjustments land HERE — never in CLAUDE_MANAGER.md, which is the AI-facing directive surface. Per-project: each install tunes its own copy.
_meta.consumers: token-cost-monitor (first consumer — reads the cost block below); manager-optimizer (second consumer, Phase 53 — reads the optimizer block below, and DRAFTS adjustments to existing keys and the operation_tiers/friction slots for the user's approval; approval-gated autonomy holds).
_meta.routing_rule: AI-directive changes -> CLAUDE_MANAGER.md. Human/gate adjustments -> this file. Nothing in Phase 48 writes to this file programmatically; edits are human edits.

schema.cost: Live (Phase 48). enabled: master switch for ambient cost surfaces. assumed_model: pricing row from telemetry/model-pricing.json used for dollar estimates (telemetry does not record the model, so estimates must state their assumption). warn_usd_per_session: compared against the PER-SITTING delta (latest rollup minus the prior checkpoint in the same lineage; delta == total for un-resumed sessions) — not the cumulative lineage figure (Phase 66). warn_usd_per_7d: trailing-7-day per-lineage window delta. Both estimates at assumed_model rates. Display (Phase 91), three states: a threshold trip prints the full dollar line (API-equiv label, !! marker); fewer than 3 clean sitting samples prints the same absolute form (no baseline, no relative claim); otherwise ONE relative line — sitting vs the median of clean per-sitting deltas (delta > 0, spacing <= 2 days, headline excluded), 7d as % of threshold — with no dollars. Recording and threshold logic are independent of display state.
schema.operation_tiers: Live (Phase 85). Descriptive classification of the five operation classes per ROADMAP Appendix — reads / scratch_writes / repo_writes / destructive_external / credentials_financial_pii. Classification only; lanes live in the friction block. tier_5 appears HERE (as a class that exists) but never in friction (as a knob that could move).
schema.friction: Live (Phase 85; polarity inverted Phase 104). The DEFAULT is flow_with_receipt: tier_3's base lane flows, and the ship report + commit body ARE the oversight surface. tier_3_class_overrides now enumerates the GATES - the irreversibility set (deletion, history_rewrite, config_value_change, template_structural, values_call) at surface_choice; everything reversible inherits the flowing base. Rationale: gates most users click through produce habituation, not review - the product gates only where one beat of hesitation has real expected value, and gating rarely is what keeps that beat meaningful. tier_4 keeps its configurable lane above the NON-configurable destructive-pattern hard floor (PreToolUse hooks); tier_5 remains structurally absent from friction - no lane may bypass the hooks.
schema.optimizer: Live (Phase 53). enabled: master switch for the SessionStart nudge line. run_every_sessions: sessions-since-last-run threshold at which the nudge fires. nudge_cooldown_sessions: minimum sessions between nudge lines. The counter itself lives in the gitignored runtime file telemetry/optimizer-state.json.
schema.audits: Live (Phase 74). Registry of dispatch-class audits on session-count cadences (sessions, never calendar time). Per entry: enabled (master switch) + sessions_between_dispatches (the cadence). Counters live in gitignored telemetry/audit-state.json, incremented every SessionEnd for every registered audit; the manager's dispatch flow resets an entry at dispatch. Extensible: future dispatch-class audits register here. Registrants: artifact_fit_analyzer (Phase 74) + plugin_discovery (Phase 76 — plugin-ecosystem inventory into the draft recommendation manifest). The skeleton repo itself additionally registers roadmap_auditor (Phase 75, dogfood-only — it never ships in template).
